_about: Frozen inputs for the April 23, 2026 BANR pitch memo. build_pitch.py uses this file by default so a rebuild reproduces the published figures exactly; pass --live to re-pull SEC EDGAR + Yahoo Finance data instead. Values were taken from pnw_banks_comp.xlsx, which was written by the same April 23, 2026 run that produced banr_pitch.pdf.
revision_note: Text and formatting revised October 2026, with two corrections: BANR's ROE lead over HFWA is 37% (previously misstated as 24%), and loan/deposit now uses fiscal 2025 net loans (84%, previously 78%). Price target and valuation figures unchanged from April 23, 2026.
fundamentals_source: Most recent 10-K filings (fiscal 2025) via SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts API
market_data_source: Yahoo Finance (yfinance) quote data pulled April 23, 2026
known_data_caveats: Corrected October 2026: net loans are now the FY2025 values (the original April build paired an older XBRL loans tag, FY2023 for BANR, with FY2025 deposits, which showed BANR's loan/deposit as 78%; the FY2025 figure is 84%). Loan/deposit does not enter the valuation, so the target is unchanged.
The 13.5x normalized P/E is a fixed community-bank assumption, not BANR's own historical average.
